summary: P0+P1+P2 UX batch verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (public events stubs return the expected empty payloads / 404, flutter single-active dedup returns 409 `flutter_already_active` and resets after read, self-flutter reads '🦋 a flutter to yourself', respond endpoint accepts fluttered_back and keeps the flutter in the recipient list with read=False, invalid action → 400, unknown id → 404, self-DM via `/api/dm/start` returns participants=[same,same], regression notices/groups/events still work for frankie). Frontend: Chats tab shows the pinned '📝 Notes to Myself' card; tapping it opens a self-DM whose header reads 'Notes to Myself' and has NO dm-report-user flag icon. Events tab renders 'Host a new event' plus all six filter pills; navigating /events → /events/new → /events produces ZERO 404 console errors. Notice Board shows all 8 emoji-prefixed filter chips (📢 Announcement, ❓ Question, 🎉 Event, ❤️ Kindness, 🛒 Buy & Sell, 🏡 Community, 🙋 Help Needed, 🎁 Giveaway) and the '+ Add Post' modal re-uses the same emoji category chips. /moments/new dashed 'Add' square opens a native-style sheet with 'Take Photo', 'Choose from Library' and 'Cancel'. Find Friends: tapping 'Add' immediately flips the button to 'Request Sent ✓' and the state persists after navigating away and back. George bubble auto-dismisses (bubble was gone within ~5s of login) and did NOT overlap the pinned Notes to Myself card on the Chats screen.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend stubs (server.py:10247–10269) return the exact envelopes the client expects: `{events: []}`, `{items: []}`, and 404 for unknown slug — matches the review's 'INTENTIONALLY empty stubs' note.

Flutter single-active guard (server.py:8801–8814) correctly exempts self-flutters (from==to) and returns 409 with `detail={error:'flutter_already_active', ...}` so the client can flip the button label.
Self-flutter wording (server.py:8831–8832) reads '🦋 a flutter to yourself — a little nudge for later' — passes the substring check.
flutters/{id}/respond (server.py:8872–8890) sets responded_action but does NOT set read=True, so the flutter stays in `GET /api/flutters/{user_id}` (verified in test).
dm/start (server.py:9249–9266) with user_id==other_id returns participants=[same,same] — correct behaviour for the Notes-to-Myself pinned card.

chats.tsx:352-386 pinned Notes-to-Myself card carries testID='chats-notes-to-myself'; app/dm/[id].tsx:32,89-101 gates the flag icon on !isSelfDm, so the report-user Pressable is entirely absent on a self-DM.
notices.tsx:23-38 CATEGORY_LIST + CATS + POST_CATS all derive from the same source, so filter chips (line 302-310) and post-composer chips (line 367-371) both render '<emoji> <label>' consistently.
moments/new.tsx:296 dashed square carries testID='moment-add-photo' → opens Modal (line 458+) with 'Take Photo' / 'Choose from Library' / 'Cancel' — matches spec.

friends.tsx:148 uses optimistic UI to flip the button state to 'Request Sent ✓' immediately after api call, and the state hydrates from server on focus (line 80) so it persists across navigation — confirmed by the Playwright nav-and-back check.

Stale-data note: `db.users` had `maggie.blocked = [frankie.id]` from a previous iteration; the test suite auto-clears this in its module-scoped fixture so the frankie→maggie flow is deterministic. Not a functional bug in this batch.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture cleared maggie->frankie block entry (stale from prior iteration) so /flutters/send from frankie→maggie is not 403'd. Created a couple of TEST_-prefixed notice/group/event rows for regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0+P1+P2 items in iter134 pass. Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter134_ux_batch.py — run with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter134_ux_batch.py`. Note: the fixtures auto-clear the (stale) maggie→frankie block entry in the DB so the flutter dedup path is testable. The George greeting bubble auto-dismiss and non-overlap were confirmed empirically (bubble absent by the time Chats loaded); a subsequent iteration wanting stricter timing checks could instrument the bubble mount/unmount with a testID probe.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested behaviours behave as specified. Only bookkeeping issue found was stale test data (maggie.blocked contains frankie.id) which was worked around inside the test fixture, not fixed in application code.
